manifest.description: Diagnose short-lived Java framework context captured into longer-lived state through paths the container cannot police.
when_to_use: request, session, UI, transaction, security, or DSL context may be stored in a field, cache, static, singleton, or async closure
framework annotations do not expose the lifetime mismatch directly
a correction plan needs parameter passing, Provider use, scope bridge, or state relocation
anti_patterns: do not use for annotation scope mismatches the framework already reports
do not use for transient local reads that are not stored or escaped
do not use on non-Java targets
